profile_text.body:
Unisys is a public company traded under the ticker UIS, and it describes itself on its website as a global technology solutions company for cloud, AI, digital workplace, applications and enterprise computing. It says it offers strategic AI advisory, solution development, and scalable infrastructure, along with change management expertise, and that its cloud solutions cover migration, modernization and cloud management across hosts including AWS, Azure, Google, and customer data centers. The site also describes agentic AI-driven service desk support, field services, and device subscription options, and it points to an AI & Cloud Insights Report 2026 and peer-reviewed quantum computing research from its team.

The site presents Unisys as positioning AI as a central part of its offerings, with language about turning AI investments into business results and about AI governance. CEO Mike Thomson is quoted on why AI governance cannot wait for policy to catch up and what a governance framework requires. The site notes that some content may be created or assisted by AI and that Unisys reviews content for accuracy and quality but does not guarantee it is free from errors or omissions.

Beyond the company profile, the record holds no tracked products, no lawsuits, and no MCP servers for Unisys.
